description: Welcome to our family apartment in the heart of the Rive Gauche. You will be able to live warm moments with your family while enjoying its calm and its view on a magnificent garden and even on the Eiffel Tower! With a surface of 130 square meters, it is composed of a large living room with a neat decoration and 4 bedrooms (one of which is double). It has two bathrooms, 2 toilets (one separate) and an open kitchen. We hope with all our heart that you will feel at home here!Guest accessThe whole apartmentRegistration details7510707472060
